name: Windows 11
description: Official installer image from Microsoft, for a clean install or an in-place repair install. Choose "Download Windows 11 Disk Image (ISO)" on the page.

name: Windows 10
description: Official installer from Microsoft. On a Windows PC the page offers the Media Creation Tool, which builds the ISO or a USB stick.

name: macOS installers
description: Apple's page with links to each macOS version in the App Store and instructions for making a bootable installer. Apple does not publish ISO files.

name: Hiren's BootCD PE
description: A bootable Windows environment with a large set of free repair, recovery and diagnostic tools.

name: SystemRescue
description: A bootable Linux rescue system with TestDisk, ddrescue, GParted and file system repair tools.

name: MediCat USB
description: A very large technician toolkit built on Ventoy: Windows PE environments, antivirus scanners, partition and imaging tools and diagnostics in one menu. Needs a 32 GB or larger stick.

name: Ultimate Boot CD
description: A long-standing collection of drive maker diagnostics, memory tests and low-level utilities. Best for older, BIOS-based computers.

name: ESET SysRescue Live
description: Scans and cleans a computer for malware from outside Windows, for infections that block normal scanners.

name: Super Grub2 Disk
description: Starts an installed system whose boot loader is broken, so it can be repaired from inside.

name: Boot-Repair-Disk
description: A live disc with a one-click repair for computers that will not start after an update or a dual-boot install.

name: Finnix
description: A small text-only Linux rescue system for administrators. Starts fast on almost anything.

name: netboot.xyz
description: A tiny boot image that downloads and starts installers and rescue systems over the internet from one menu. Needs a wired connection.

name: GParted Live
description: Bootable partition editor for resizing, moving and creating partitions.

name: Clonezilla Live
description: Clones a drive to another drive or to an image file. Text menus, very reliable.

name: Rescuezilla
description: Drive imaging and cloning with a simple point-and-click window. Works with Clonezilla images.

name: ShredOS
description: Securely erases whole drives before resale or disposal, using nwipe. Everything on the chosen drives is destroyed.

name: Memtest86+
description: Tests the memory for faults. Leave it running for several passes, ideally overnight.

name: MemTest86 (PassMark)
description: A memory tester with a free edition, an alternative to Memtest86+ with more detailed reports. Supplied as a USB image.

name: SeaTools Bootable
description: Seagate's drive diagnostic, run from a USB stick. Tests drives from any maker.

name: Ubuntu Desktop
description: Runs as a live system from the stick to rescue files or test hardware, and installs as a replacement for an unsupported Windows.

name: Linux Mint
description: A Linux system with a familiar Windows-like desktop. A good fit for older computers that cannot run Windows 11.

name: Fedora Workstation
description: An up-to-date Linux system with strong support for recent hardware.

name: Debian
description: A very stable Linux system. Live images are available for testing hardware before installing.

name: Zorin OS
description: A Linux system designed to feel familiar to Windows users, with a Lite edition for older computers.

name: Pop!_OS
description: A polished Linux system with good graphics driver support, including an image with NVIDIA drivers built in.

name: Xubuntu
description: Ubuntu with a lighter desktop, for computers with 4 GB of memory or less.

name: MX Linux
description: A light, fast Linux system that runs well on old hardware and includes its own live-USB tools.

name: ChromeOS Flex
description: Google's system for turning an old PC or Mac into a Chromebook-style computer. Supplied as an installer image made with the Chromebook Recovery Utility, not an ISO.

name: Ventoy
description: Not an ISO. Install Ventoy on a USB stick once, then copy any of these ISO files onto it and choose one at startup. Also in the Tools screen.

name: Rufus
description: Not an ISO. Writes a single ISO to a USB stick, and can build a Windows 11 installer that skips the hardware checks. Also in the Tools screen.

name: balenaEtcher
description: Not an ISO. Writes an image to a USB stick on Windows, macOS and Linux with three clicks.
